description: The file defines the 'Customer' class within the 'Opencart\Admin\Model\Customer' namespace. It implements various methods for managing customer data, including adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving customers and related data. The class extends a system engine model, indicating it's part of a larger OpenCart system architecture.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: Represents customer management functionalities including creation, update, deletion, and retrieval of customer data.

methods.name: addCustomer
methods.description: Inserts a new customer into the database using provided data, returning the new customer's ID.

methods.name: editCustomer
methods.description: Updates existing customer data identified by customer ID with new data.

methods.name: editToken
methods.description: Updates the token associated with a specific customer.

methods.name: editCommenter
methods.description: Sets the 'commenter' status for a specific customer.

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Removes a customer and all related data from the database identified by customer ID.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific customer by ID, including custom fields.

methods.name: getCustomerByEmail
methods.description: Finds and returns customer data based on email address.

methods.name: getCustomers
methods.description: Fetches a list of customers with optional filters and sorting.

methods.name: getTotalCustomers
methods.description: Retrieves the total count of customers matching optional filters.

methods.name: getTotalCustomersByCustomerGroupId
methods.description: Counts customers belonging to a specific customer group.

methods.name: deleteActivities
methods.description: Deletes customer activities based on customer ID.

methods.name: addAddress
methods.description: Adds a new address for a customer and returns the address ID.

methods.name: editAddress
methods.description: Edits an existing address for a customer based on address ID.

methods.name: deleteAddresses
methods.description: Deletes address(es) for a customer, optionally by specific address ID.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific address, including country and zone info.

methods.name: getAddresses
methods.description: Retrieves all addresses for a customer.

methods.name: getTotalAddresses
methods.description: Counts total addresses for a customer.

methods.name: getTotalAddressesByCountryId
methods.description: Counts addresses filtered by country ID.

methods.name: getTotalAddressesByZoneId
methods.description: Counts addresses filtered by zone ID.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Adds a history entry (comment) related to a customer.

methods.name: deleteHistories
methods.description: Deletes all history entries for a customer.

methods.name: getHistories
methods.description: Retrieves paginated history comments for a customer.

methods.name: getTotalHistories
methods.description: Counts total history entries for a customer.

methods.name: addWishlists
methods.description: Deletes wishlist entries for a customer.

methods.name: addTransaction
methods.description: Records a financial transaction for a customer.

methods.name: deleteTransactions
methods.description: Deletes all transactions for a customer.

methods.name: deleteTransactionsByOrderId
methods.description: Deletes transaction entries associated with a specific order ID.

methods.name: getTransactions
methods.description: Retrieves paginated transaction records for a customer.

methods.name: getTransactionByCustomerId
methods.description: Retrieves customer transaction records with pagination.

methods.name: getTotalTransactions
methods.description: Gets total count of transactions for a customer.

methods.name: getTotalTransactionsByOrderId
methods.description: Counts customer transactions for a specific order ID.

methods.name: addReward
methods.description: Adds a reward points record for a customer associated with an order and description.

methods.name: deleteRewards
methods.description: Deletes reward points for a customer.

methods.name: deleteRewardsByOrderId
methods.description: Deletes reward points entries associated with a specific order ID where points are greater than zero.

methods.name: getRewards
methods.description: Fetches rewards for a customer with pagination.

methods.name: getTotalRewards
methods.description: Gets the total count of reward records for a customer.

methods.name: getTotalRewardsByOrderId
methods.description: Counts reward entries associated with a specific order ID where points are greater than zero.

methods.name: getRewardTotal
methods.description: Calculates the sum of reward points for a customer.

methods.name: getTotalRewards
methods.description: Gets the total number of reward entries for a customer.

methods.name: getTotalRewardsByOrderId
methods.description: Counts the reward entries for a specific order ID with points greater than zero.

methods.name: getTotalRewards
methods.description: Retrieve the number of reward point records for a customer.

methods.name: getRewardTotal
methods.description: Sum of all reward points earned by a customer.

methods.name: getTotalRewardsByOrderId
methods.description: Count reward entries for a particular order.

methods.name: deleteIps
methods.description: Deletes stored IP addresses for a customer.

methods.name: getIps
methods.description: Retrieves IP addresses associated with a customer, with pagination.

methods.name: getTotalIps
methods.description: Counts total IP entries for a customer.

methods.name: getTotalCustomersByIp
methods.description: Counts customers associated with a specific IP address.

methods.name: deleteAuthorizes
methods.description: Deletes authorization records for a customer, optionally by specific customer_authorize_id.

methods.name: getAuthorizeByToken
methods.description: Retrieves authorization data matching a specific token for a customer.

methods.name: getAuthorizes
methods.description: List authorizations for a customer with pagination.

methods.name: getTotalAuthorizes
methods.description: Counts total authorization records for a customer.

methods.name: editAuthorizeStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a customer authorization record.

methods.name: editAuthorizeTotal
methods.description: Sets the total value for a customer authorization.

methods.name: resetAuthorizes
methods.description: Resets total authorization values to zero for a customer.

methods.name: deleteAuthorizes
methods.description: Deletes authorization records, optionally by a specific authorization ID.
